Stripe

Senior Full-Stack Engineer

Stripe is building economic infrastructure for the internet. As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Global Payments and Connect teams, you will architect mission-critical customer-facing interfaces and high-scale distributed backend services.

Responsibilities:

  • Build intuitive, ultra-reliable payment checkout experiences using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend architectures.
  • Design and scale low-latency backend microservices handling millions of API transactions per minute with Node.js, Go, and PostgreSQL.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Security teams to ensure flawless transaction integrity and PCI compliance.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of production experience in full-stack web applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL), distributed caching (Redis), and REST / GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience with test-driven development, automated CI/CD pipelines, and high availability system design.
